When a t"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ask is complex, it decomposes the task into subtasks and dispatches each to the sub-agent model best"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" suited for it (GLM / Kimi / Qwen / any OpenAI-compatible route you configure), "},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-multi-model-orchestrator"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that turns your primary AI into a **multi-model "main brain"**. When"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" a task is complex, it decomposes the task into subtasks and dispatches each to the sub-agent model "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"best suited for it (GLM / Kimi / Qwen / any OpenAI-compatible route you configure), while tracking *"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"*per-model token usage**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"1. **Multi-model orchestration guidance** — a system-prompt section coaches the main brain to decomp"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ose complex tasks, inspect available routes with `list_subagent_models`, and dispatch each subtask v"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ia `subagent` with an explicit `provider` / `model`.
2. **Model-aware dispatch** — you describe each"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" route's strengths/weaknesses once (see config); the main brain assigns work accordingly (strong mod"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"els for hard reasoning, fast/cheap ones for high-volume work).
3. **Per-model token usage** — a `mod"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"el_token_usage` tool reports input / output / cache read / cache write tokens and request counts per"},{"id":"p5s7","text":" `provider/model`, accumulated since the process started."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The plugin does **not** touch any harness internals. All model routes and the sub-agent allow-list a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"re ordinary harness settings — see examples/settings.yaml."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Install into a dsh profile (usually `web`):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"or, from a git checkout:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Restart the harness (or reload the profile) afterwards. The plugin loads itself as a profile layer v"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ia its `cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. **Add your third-party model routes** to `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` (default `~/.dsh/settings.yaml"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"`). GLM / Kimi / Qwen presets ready to paste: see examples/settings.yaml. Each route needs only an A"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"PI key behind `apiKeyEnv` (env var, `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, or the web **Models** page)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"2. **Enable sub-agent model selection** so the main brain can pick the model for each child:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"3. **(Optional) Add model notes** the main brain reads when assigning work:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"4. Restart the harness and ask, e.g.:
> Break this into parallel subtasks and dispatch each to the b"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" the harness and ask, e.g.:
> Break this into parallel subtasks and dispatch each to the best model."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Credentials"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Keys are resolved per request through each route's `apiKeyEnv`. Provide them any of these ways:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Environment variables**: `GLM_API_KEY` / `KIMI_API_KEY` / `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` (per your route na"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"mes).
- **Credential store** `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Web "Models" page**: paste the key directly (stored in the managed credential document)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Routes without a key fail at request time with `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` and do not affect configured one"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"utes without a key fail at request time with `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` and do not affect configured ones."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How the main brain works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Ask for a complex task in the main conversation. The main brain will:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"1. use `todo_write` to record the decomposed subtasks;
2. call `list_subagent_models` to see availab"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"le routes;
3. dispatch each subtask through `subagent` (with `provider` / `model`) to the best-fit m"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"odel — launching independent delegations in one message, running them in the background by default;
"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"4. gather results and synthesize the final deliverable."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"> **Route names are whatever your profile actually registers** — the GLM / Kimi / Qwen names in the "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"examples are illustrative. If you registered routes under other providers (e.g. a `zai` gateway), re"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ference those exact `provider`/`model` ids in `subagent-model-selection` and `modelNotes`. Ask `list"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"_subagent_models` for the live list."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"To see usage, ask the main brain to call `model_token_usage` (or just ask "how many tokens has each "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ask the main brain to call `model_token_usage` (or just ask "how many tokens has each model used?")."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Configuration reference"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Everything is configured in `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Section | Purpose |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `llm-pi-ai.providers` | OpenAI-compatible third-party model routes (any vendor). |
| `subagent-mod"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"el-selection` | Allow-list of `{provider, model}` the sub-agent tool may dispatch to. |
| `multi-mod"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"el-orchestrator.modelNotes` | Per-route strengths/weaknesses that guide assignment. |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"To add your own vendor, extend `llm-pi-ai.providers` with `{ api, baseURL, apiKeyEnv, models }` (any"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" OpenAI-compatible `api: openai-completions` gateway works), then add matching entries to `subagent-"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"model-selection.allowedModels` and `multi-model-orchestrator.modelNotes`."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Notes & limitations"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Token usage is **per-process** (cleared when the harness restarts); per-session usage still shows "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"in the built-in token meter.
- `model_token_usage` needs at least one model call that returned a `us"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"age` chunk before it reports anything.
- The orchestration guidance is injected globally, so sub-age"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"nts read it too; its wording keeps sub-agents from recursively re-decomposing their single focused s"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"ubtask.
- Third-party routes are registered as **non-reasoning** models by default; reasoning flags "},{"id":"p37s6","text":"(`reasoningEfforts` / `compat.thinkingFormat`) can be added per model on the web **Models** page.
- "},{"id":"p37s7","text":"**Some reasoning models reject a call without an explicit reasoning tier.** Zhipu's GLM-5.3 line, fo"},{"id":"p37s8","text":"r example, fails with default parameters and only responds when the sub-agent is dispatched with an "},{"id":"p37s9","text":"explicit `reasoning_effort` (e.g. `low`). If a dispatched child errors on a model you expect to work"},{"id":"p37s10","text":", add an explicit `reasoning_effort` to the dispatch. A route that returns no tokens despite request"},{"id":"p37s11","text":"s succeeding at the API level is usually a provider-side issue, not an orchestrator bug."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/...'`** — the plugin was linked manuall"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"y (raw `link:` + a hand-made `node_modules` junction) instead of installed through `dsh plugin ... a"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"dd`. Install it as a real dependency of the profile and remove the junction.
